import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w=w[w.year.notna()].copy()
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
ap=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count');w['aprod']=np.log(ap)
print(len(w), w.y.mean())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    g=g.dropna();return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).y.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
gs=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(1000):
    bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for c in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']: print(pd.crosstab(w[c],w.late,normalize='columns').round(3))

h=w[w.date_confidence=='high'];print('high',est(h),len(h))
